question: What is your refund policy for annual subscription plans?
context: Annual subscription plans are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are prorated based on unused months, minus a 5% processing fee. Refund requests must be submitted through the billing portal.
expected_answer: Annual plans can be fully refunded within 30 days of purchase; after that, refunds are prorated for unused months minus a 5% processing fee, and must be requested through the billing portal.

question: How long does standard shipping take for domestic orders?
context: Standard domestic shipping takes 3-5 business days. Expedited shipping is available for an additional fee and delivers within 1-2 business days. Orders placed after 2pm ET ship the following business day.
expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping takes 3 to 5 business days; expedited shipping (extra fee) takes 1 to 2 business days.

question: Can I change my plan from monthly to annual billing mid-cycle?
context: Customers can switch from monthly to annual billing at any time from account settings. The switch takes effect immediately, and any unused monthly balance is credited toward the new annual charge on a prorated basis.
expected_answer: Yes, you can switch to annual billing at any time from account settings; the switch is immediate and any unused monthly balance is prorated and credited toward the annual charge.

question: What happens to my data if I cancel my account?
context: Upon cancellation, account data is retained for 90 days in case of reactivation. After 90 days, all data is permanently deleted from production systems, though anonymized usage logs may be retained for up to one year for analytics purposes.
expected_answer: Your data is retained for 90 days after cancellation in case you reactivate, then permanently deleted from production systems; anonymized usage logs may persist up to a year.

question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofit or educational organizations?
context: Verified nonprofit organizations receive a 20% discount on all annual plans. Educational institutions receive a 30% discount with a valid .edu email or institutional verification. Discounts cannot be combined with other promotions.
expected_answer: Yes: verified nonprofits get 20% off annual plans, and educational institutions get 30% off with valid verification; discounts can't be combined with other promotions.

question: What security certifications does your platform hold?
context: The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified and ISO 27001 compliant. Annual third-party penetration tests are conducted, and results summaries are available to enterprise customers under NDA upon request.
expected_answer: The platform holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications, with annual third-party penetration testing; enterprise customers can request summaries under NDA.

question: How do I set up single sign-on (SSO) for my organization?
context: SSO is available on Business and Enterprise plans via SAML 2.0. Admins configure SSO under Organization Settings > Security by uploading their identity provider's metadata XML. Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace are officially supported.
expected_answer: SSO (SAML 2.0) is available on Business/Enterprise plans; admins configure it under Organization Settings > Security by uploading their identity provider's metadata XML. Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace are officially supported.

question: What is the maximum file size I can upload as an attachment?
context: Individual file attachments are limited to 25MB on Free and Pro plans, and 250MB on Business and Enterprise plans. Files exceeding the limit can be shared via an external link instead.
expected_answer: Attachments are limited to 25MB on Free/Pro plans and 250MB on Business/Enterprise plans; larger files can be shared via an external link.

question: Why was my payment declined even though my card has sufficient funds?
context: Payments can be declined by the issuing bank for reasons unrelated to available balance, including fraud-prevention holds, incorrect billing address on file, or the card not being enabled for international/recurring transactions. We recommend contacting your bank or updating the billing address in account settings.
expected_answer: Even with sufficient funds, a payment can be declined due to bank fraud holds, a mismatched billing address, or the card not being enabled for recurring/international charges; try updating your billing address or contacting your bank.

question: Is there a mobile app available for iOS and Android?
context: Native apps are available for both iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). The mobile apps support core features including messaging, notifications, and file viewing, but advanced admin configuration is only available on the web dashboard.
expected_answer: Yes, native iOS and Android apps are available; they support core features like messaging and notifications, but advanced admin configuration requires the web dashboard.

question: How does your API rate limiting work and what are the limits?
context: The public API enforces a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per API key on the Free tier, 1000 requests per minute on Pro, and custom limits negotiated for Enterprise. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header indicating when the window resets.
expected_answer: API rate limits are 100 req/min on Free, 1000 req/min on Pro, and custom for Enterprise; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

question: Can I export all my data before closing my account?
context: A full data export can be requested from Account Settings > Data Export, which generates a downloadable ZIP archive containing all records in JSON and CSV formats. Export generation typically completes within 24 hours and the download link is valid for 7 days.
expected_answer: Yes, request a full export from Account Settings > Data Export; it generates a ZIP with JSON/CSV files within about 24 hours, with a download link valid for 7 days.

question: What happens if I exceed my plan's storage quota?
context: When storage usage exceeds the plan quota, new uploads are blocked but existing data remains accessible. Account admins receive email warnings at 80%, 95%, and 100% of quota. Upgrading the plan or deleting files restores upload capability immediately.
expected_answer: Exceeding your storage quota blocks new uploads (existing data stays accessible); admins get warnings at 80/95/100%, and upgrading or deleting files restores upload capability immediately.

question: Do you support webhooks for real-time event notifications?
context: Webhooks can be configured under Developer Settings > Webhooks for events including record.created, record.updated, and user.invited. Payloads are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Signature header for verification. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff up to 5 times.
expected_answer: Yes, webhooks are configured under Developer Settings for events like record.created/updated and user.invited; payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed, and failed deliveries retry with exponential backoff up to 5 times.

question: What is the difference between the Business and Enterprise plans?
context: Business plans include up to 50 seats, standard support with 24-hour response SLA, and 250MB attachment limits. Enterprise plans include unlimited seats, a dedicated account manager, custom contract terms, 4-hour support SLA, SSO, and audit logging.
expected_answer: Business supports up to 50 seats with a 24-hour support SLA and 250MB attachments, while Enterprise offers unlimited seats, a dedicated account manager, custom contracts, a 4-hour SLA, SSO, and audit logging.

question: How is my payment card information stored and secured?
context: Card data is never stored on our servers; all payment processing is delegated to a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified processor, and we retain only a tokenized reference to the card for recurring billing. Full card numbers are never accessible to our support staff.
expected_answer: Card data isn't stored on our servers at all — payments go through a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified processor, and we only keep a tokenized reference for recurring billing; support staff never see full card numbers.

question: What time zone are billing dates and usage resets based on?
context: All billing cycles and monthly usage quota resets are calculated in UTC, regardless of the account's configured display time zone. Invoices show both the UTC billing date and the equivalent date in the account's local time zone for clarity.
expected_answer: Billing cycles and usage resets are calculated in UTC regardless of your display time zone; invoices show both the UTC date and your local equivalent.

question: Can multiple users collaborate on the same document simultaneously?
context: Real-time collaborative editing is supported for up to 25 concurrent editors per document. Changes are synced via operational transformation with sub-second latency under normal network conditions, and a version history keeps snapshots every 5 minutes.
expected_answer: Yes, up to 25 people can edit a document simultaneously in real time, with changes synced via operational transformation and version snapshots saved every 5 minutes.

question: What is your policy on subprocessors and data residency for EU customers?
context: EU customer data is processed exclusively in EU-based data centers (Frankfurt and Dublin) to comply with GDPR. A current list of subprocessors is published and customers are notified via email at least 30 days before any subprocessor change takes effect, with the right to object.
expected_answer: EU customer data stays in EU data centers (Frankfurt/Dublin) for GDPR compliance; a public subprocessor list is maintained, and customers get 30 days' notice with the right to object before any subprocessor change.

question: How do I recover a deleted project within the retention window?
context: Deleted projects move to a Trash folder and remain recoverable for 30 days by any workspace admin from Settings > Trash. After 30 days, projects are purged permanently and cannot be recovered by anyone, including support staff.
expected_answer: Deleted projects sit in Trash and can be restored by a workspace admin for 30 days via Settings > Trash; after that they're permanently purged and unrecoverable, even by support.
